Arkham launches spot trading platform in US. Japan to implement crypto tax reform.

entry.title: Nym Launching 'World's First Decentralized Mixnet' VPN: CEO
entry.summary: Nym CEO Harry Halpin sat down with Decrypt's Stephen Graves at Web Summit to talk about what makes its mixnet VPN unique, the global crackdown on privacy projects, and whether crypto's "honeymoon" with the Trump administration will last.
